description.narrative: The proposed project will jumpstart a long-term transition towards a zero tailpipe-emission transport sector in the Kyrgyz Republic. It will comprise four interlinked outputs: (i) zero-emission tailpipe bus fleet in Bishkek municipality upgraded; (ii) bus depot infrastructure upgraded; (iii) pilot green mobility corridor established; and (iv) Bishkek bus operation sustainability improved. The project is economically justified by the reduced need for fossil fuel imports, vehicle operating cost savings, better air quality, and reduced carbon emissions, which will promote energy security, improve public health, and contribute to climate change mitigation. The project will also make Bishkek more livable and foster gender equity.

Annual air pollutant emissions of the Bishkek municipality-owned public bus fleet reduced by 1.8 tons for PM2.5 and 98 tons for NOx, compared with no-project scenario (2021 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: On track to achieve target. The contract for Package 1 for the Supply and Delivery of Battery Electric Bus Fleet and Charging Infrastructure was signed on 2 Nov 2022. The Project was declared effective on 21 December 2022. The government fulfilled the conditions for withdrawal from the loan and grant accounts which ADB confirmed on 15 March 2023. The contract with the Project Management and Construction Supervision Consultant was signed on 25 May 2023. The contract for the procurement of Package 2 (civil works upgrade for bus depots) was signed on 9 September 2024. The construction works started on 23 September 2024. The civil works at Depot 2 were completed on 21 May 2025, while those at Depot 1 were completed by 30 June 2025.
The two e-bus prototypes including 1 charging unit were delivered on 1 April 2025. As of 25 July 2025 all 120 buses have been delivered to Bishkek. Data Source: External consultant report Actual value:

Output: Zero-emission tailpipe bus fleet in Bishkek municipality upgraded Indicator: 120 modern battery electric buses with energy usage of 1.1 kWh/km or less deployed Progress/Status: The contract for the Supply and Delivery of Battery Electric Bus (BEB) Fleet and Charging Infrastructure was signed timely on 2 November 2022. ADB disbursed the advance payment to the supplier on 11 April 2023. A technical team went to PRC in July 2023 to inspect the first completed BEB unit of the supplier to be approved by BTD prior to the delivery of the first batch of vehicles. The contract for the upgrade of the bus depots was signed on 9 September 2024, construction works started on 23 September 2024. The civil works at Depot 2 were completed by 21 May 2025, while those at Depot 1 were completed by 30 June 2025, then delivery date of the BEBs was in June and July 2025.
As of 5 Dec 2024, the production of the 2 bus prototypes were completed. The production of the remaining 118 bus units will commence after ADB's joint inspection mission (comprising the EA and ADB) and approval of the 2 prototypes in February 2025.
The two bus prototypes including 1 charging unit were delivered on 1 April 2025. As of 25 July 2025 all 120 buses have been delivered to Bishkek. Data Source: BCT annual report Actual value:

SED approved detailed design on 26 Jan 2023. During final review, the design had to be revised since there was no wind protection in the design of the depots which are important especially during the winter and the roofing was not according to the conceptual design. The detailed design including the drawings have been finalized in Jul 2023. ADB no objection for the issuance of the bidding documents was given on 3 Oct 2023. Invitation for bids was advertised on 6 Oct 2023. In Dec 2023, ADB has given its no objection for the re-tendering of Package 2. The procurement package was re-tendered in February 2024 and divided into 3 packages by specialty, i.e., (i) electrical, (ii) building, and (iii) pavement works. In August 2024, ADB provided its conditional no objection to award the contracts to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder. The contracts were awarded and signed on 9 September 2024. The construction started on 23 September 2024. The civil works at Depot 2 were completed by 21 May 2025, while those at Depot 1 were completed by 19 June 2025.
